validation_status: Checked against the GIAB v4.2.1 benchmark genotypes at these sites in HG001-HG007 (7/7 concordant, both trios Mendelian-consistent; docs/ToolsDocumentation.md 5e). Research use; A1/A2, O subtypes, cis-AB and weak phenotypes are not resolved.
reference_allele_note: GRCh38 carries the O haplotype at c.261delG: the reference lacks the G (forward-strand: lacks one C after chr9:133257521). The NON-O allele is the one-base insertion (T>TC). A sample with only reference reads at the O-defining site is therefore O/O, never A/A. All A/B-discriminating reference bases are the A-like base.
sources: Ensembl REST /vep/human/id/<rsid> (GRCh38, MANE Select ABO ENST00000644422 / NM_020469.4 numbering for the c. positions; the legacy ISBT c. numbers are used here). Fetched 2026-11-11.

variants.note: Ensembl GRCh38: allele_string -/C at 133257522-133257521 (insertion after 133257521). Reference = O (deletion) haplotype; alt (insertion) = non-O.

Ensembl VEP: forward C/A/G at 133255928; MANE ENST00000644422.3:c.803G>C is the alt G allele.
Ensembl VEP: forward C/T at 133255801; MANE c.930G>A (synonymous). Reported, not used to assign B.
